{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999

# Count how many such rows
sentinel_count = sentinel_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of rows with sentinel value (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check distribution of these rows across arms
sentinel_by_arm = data[sentinel_mask]['arm'].value_counts()
print('\nSentinel rows by arm:\n', sentinel_by_arm)

# Check distribution across severity levels
sentinel_by_severity = data[sentinel_mask]['severity'].value_counts()
print('\nSentinel rows by severity:\n', sentinel_by_severity)

# Check distribution across sites
sentinel_by_site = data[sentinel_mask]['site'].value_counts()
print('\nSentinel rows by site:\n', sentinel_by_site)"}
